title: Anthropic · 定价来源更新
summary: 定价页从 Claude Haiku 4.5 更新至 5.5，并改为按 prompt 长度区分价格，移除旧示例计算，反映定价策略调整。

pairs.after: Claude Haiku 5.5 is priced by prompt length: a request whose prompt is over 100,000 tokens pays higher prices. A request's prompt length counts all of its input tokens, including cache reads and cache writes. Each request is priced on its own: a request over the threshold pays the higher prices even when part of its prompt is a cache hit, and earlier requests keep the prices they were billed at. Model pricing and Batch processing list both sets of prices.
